info.description: FirstElement CRM & Helpdesk API. Errors follow the stable /api/v1 error contract.

tags.name: Clinic Schedules
tags.description: Resources, slot reservations, waitlist and dispatch queue.

tags.name: AI Drafts
tags.description: The pending, human-reviewable AI draft on a conversation. Read-only by design: nothing here sends anything.

tags.name: Clinic
tags.description: Read-only clinic roster, catalogue, schedule and analytics.

tags.name: Clinic administration
tags.description: Clinic locations and the service catalogue. Reads are roster-adjacent; writes require clinic:manage or procedure:manage.

tags.name: Clinic staff administration
tags.description: Doctor profiles and front-desk accounts. The doctor list discloses contact details, so it requires doctor:read-management rather than doctor:read.

format.description: The artefact format. One of [CSV, DOCX]. Absent means 'CSV'. The database's "ExportFormat" enum also declares XLSX, PDF and JSON, which this renderer does not produce; a request for one of those is refused with EXPORT_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED (422) rather than producing a file whose extension lies about its contents.

locale.description: The language of the artefact's labels, dates and numbers. One of [ar, en]. Absent means 'ar', because the product is Arabic-first. An undeclared locale is refused (400) rather than rendered in another language: a file that looks right and is in the wrong language is the worst outcome this subsystem can produce.

key.description: Required. report_definitions_key_check: a report is named by its key, and a blank one names nothing.

nameAr.description: Required. report_definitions_name_ar_check: the product is Arabic-first, so a report with no Arabic name is dead configuration.

nameEn.description: Required. report_definitions_name_en_check: the product is bilingual, so a report with no English name is dead configuration.

timezone.description: Required. report_definitions_timezone_check: a report that buckets by day must not inherit the server's zone, or the same report produces different numbers on two workers; the zone must therefore be declared, and it must be an IANA zone PostgreSQL knows.

redactionPolicy.description: Required. report_definitions_redaction_policy_check: an undeclared policy would make the job's redactionPolicy column a claim rather than a decision. One of none, no-contact-details, no-personal-detail, strict.

retentionClass.description: Required. report_definitions_retention_class_check: the retention class decides what an operator may purge, so a definition without one has artefacts with no window.

columns.description: Required. report_versions_columns_shape_check: a report that selects nothing exports nothing, so it is not a report.

measures.description: Required. report_versions_measures_present_check: a report with no measure is not a report.

successorVersion.description: Required. report_versions_retired_check: it requires retiredAt and supersededByVersionId, and a retirement that does not say where the body went is not a rollback, it is a deletion with extra steps.

key.description: Required. document_templates_key_check: a template is named by its key, and a blank one names nothing.

nameAr.description: Required. document_templates_name_ar_check: the product is Arabic-first, so a template with no Arabic name is dead configuration.

nameEn.description: Required. document_templates_name_en_check: the product is bilingual, so a template with no English name is dead configuration.

timezone.description: Required. document_templates_timezone_check: the same real-zone validation as a report definition, so a template and the report it renders cannot disagree about what a date means.

nameAr.description: Required. report_definitions_name_ar_check: a rename that clears the Arabic name is not a rename.

nameEn.description: Required. report_definitions_name_en_check: a rename that clears the English name is not a rename.

expectedVersion.description: Required. report_definitions_version_check: the row's own version, which the update is guarded on; an unguarded rename is a last-write-wins overwrite, which is the one thing that column exists to prevent.

formats.description: Every format POST /api/v1/exports accepts. Exactly the accepted set and not the database's declared "ExportFormat" enum: offering PDF or XLSX here would be a dropdown entry that always fails with EXPORT_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED (422).

locales.description: Every locale POST /api/v1/exports accepts, and every locale a "Locale" column can store. The product is bilingual, so the set is closed rather than a free BCP-47 tag: a locale nothing can store could be stored on no column and would be answered in another language's file.

defaultFormat.description: The format used when the create request names none: CSV. A member of the formats this catalogue publishes, and asserted to be one by ExportCatalogue's own constructor.

defaultLocale.description: The locale used when the create request names none: ar, because the product is Arabic-first. A member of the locales this catalogue publishes, and asserted to be one by ExportCatalogue's own constructor.

ErrorResponse.description: The body every non-2xx response carries. The same shape for a refusal the caller can fix and for a fault the caller cannot, so the two are told apart by the status and the code rather than by the body.

code.description: The stable machine-readable code. Branch on this, not on the message: the message is written for display and may change.

message.description: A sentence written for a human. Never contains a tenant, a role, a permission, or another row's field value.

details.description: What the caller needs in order to fix the request: the accepted values, the offending field, the current version. Empty when there is nothing to recover from.

requestId.description: The correlation id. It appears in the server log line for the same failure, which is how a caller quote gets an operator to the right place.

timestamp.description: When the body was written, in UTC.

retryable.description: Whether an unchanged retry could succeed. Null where the server does not claim either way; a client must treat null as unknown, not as false.

sessionCookie.description: Server-side browser session cookie. Mutations also require the X-XSRF-TOKEN header.
